parts.name: HDPE Lateral Tubing 16mm OD (Perforated)
parts.notes: Extruded HDPE lateral with hand-drilled holes at 25cm spacing (adjustable per crop). Holes made with heated needle or drill. Simple, proven design. No custom moulds needed.

parts.name: Cotton Wick Tape
parts.notes: Strips of cotton fabric sewn or glued to lateral tubing. Water wicks through at controlled capillary rate (~0.3 L/hr per wick). No manufacturing needed — sourced or hand-sewn.

parts.name: PP Manifold Chamber
parts.notes: Accepts water input, distributes to 4 laterals via quick-connects or barbed fittings.

parts.name: PP Barbed Connector M16
parts.notes: Barbed fitting. Pushes onto 16mm OD lateral tubing. Reusable. Connects to manifold outlet.
